summary: Disoriented hiker veered off Midway Pass Trail into Coleman Creek drainage near Independence Pass; stranded ~800 vertical ft above Highway 82; cold and hungry, uninjured; Mountain Rescue Aspen (7 volunteers) Hasty Team located hiker ~8:30 PM and guided down; out of field by 9:50 PM
location: Coleman Creek drainage, Midway Pass Trail, near Independence Pass
notes: Call ~6:49 PM; Pitkin County Regional Emergency Dispatch Center.
